analysis.title: The Next Big Theme: October 2026
key_insights: Meta's Muse personal AI agent passed 5 million U.S. downloads in about three weeks after its September launch, faster than ChatGPT, Claude and Grok. It acts on users' behalf (forms, inboxes, purchases with approval).

Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full in early October, claiming they bring the company to the AI frontier after a 14-month overhaul. Upgrades first target paying subscribers, and Muse is coming to smart glasses and a new Muse Charm device, opening subscription and hardware monetization.

SpaceX agreed to buy a nationwide low-band wireless spectrum portfolio (14 MHz paired) from Grain Management, adding to its earlier $17B spectrum purchase from EchoStar. The aim is a U.S. mobile carrier service combining satellites and a terrestrial network.
The FCC approved SpaceX to deploy 15,000 next-generation Starlink mobile satellites for direct-to-device service.

Global X estimates that 10 million mobile lines at $50 per month would add $6B in annual service revenue, against SpaceX's current $11.4B connectivity business. The U.S. has an estimated 324M smartphone users in 2026.
The NRC issued the first construction permit for GE Vernova Hitachi's BWRX-300 300 MW small modular reactor at TVA's Clinch River site, which could serve as a template for later deployments.

Google and Amazon back more than $7.3B of nuclear investment through separate 20-year agreements with Constellation Energy. Google's deal adds 890 MW to PJM (first increase expected 2028). Amazon's deal covers 690 MW at Calvert Cliffs, including 190 MW of new capacity between 2030 and 2032.
Robinhood's tokenized equity trading volume rose 407% MoM to $6.57B in September, 42% of on-chain tokenized equity volume, making it the largest venue.
Robinhood's event contracts generated $156M of Q2 revenue, more than 10 times the prior year and ahead of both equities and crypto trading revenue. About 4.4B contracts traded through September 24.
Robinhood announced plans at HOOD Summit '26 to bring crypto perpetual futures to eligible U.S. customers, plus new contracts tied to corporate earnings.
The Dodge Momentum Index rose 2.4% in September, led by a 9.4% rise in institutional planning (education, healthcare, government projects).
Data center construction investment rose 7.5% in August and more than 73% YoY, a 149% annualized pace since March, per Associated Builders and Contractors.
Global semiconductor sales grew for the 18th consecutive quarter. August monthly sales were $159.7B, up 8% MoM and 144.3% YoY, and year-to-date sales passed $1T for the first time.

Semiconductor industry revenue is projected above $1.6T for 2026 (up nearly 90% YoY) and could approach $3T by 2030. Nvidia expects to double the number of chips it sells in 2027, following an earlier projection of roughly 70% revenue growth in fiscal 2028, implying about $673B.

sector_views.rationale: Consumer uptake of Meta's Muse agent points to growing interest in agentic AI and new subscription and hardware revenue.
SpaceX's spectrum purchases and FCC approval open a path into the U.S. wireless market.
A first construction permit and hyperscaler 20-year power deals give revenue certainty for modernizing the nuclear fleet.
Tokenized equities and prediction markets are diversifying Robinhood's revenue and deepening engagement.
Expanding institutional project pipelines and data center buildouts support demand for engineering services, equipment and materials.
AI demand is driving record industry sales and expectations of sustained infrastructure spending.

earnings_insights: Robinhood event contracts generated $156M of revenue in Q2 (reported), more than 10 times the prior-year level and ahead of equities and crypto trading revenue.
T-Mobile and AT&T reported monthly service revenue per postpaid phone subscriber of $50.70 and $56.60 respectively in Q4 2025 (reported).
Nvidia earlier projected roughly 70% revenue growth in fiscal 2028, implying about $673B in annual revenue (company projection).
crypto_views: Robinhood's tokenized equity trading volume rose 407% MoM to $6.57B in September, 42% of on-chain tokenized equity volume, making it the largest venue.
Robinhood plans to bring crypto perpetual futures to eligible U.S. customers.
Robinhood's tokenized equity volume cited elsewhere as part of a $15.6B record month for the on-chain tokenized equity market (CoinDesk headline in the footnotes).
risk_factors: Global X notes that narrowly focused thematic investments typically exhibit higher volatility.
Disclosed risks include rapid technological change, intense competition, obsolescence and regulation.
Space tech risks include launch failures, mission anomalies, schedule delays, capacity constraints and rising costs.
The report states there is no guarantee that the discussed deals will be completed as described.
cross_bank_references: BofA is cited (via a Yahoo Finance footnote) as seeing the U.S. semiconductor market nearly doubling by 2030.
